name: Node.js Development Environment
description: Installs the Node.js runtime with npm, and optionally enables Corepack so yarn and pnpm follow each project's packageManager field.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js version to install ('lts' resolves the newest LTS release, 'latest' the newest current release, or a specific version such as '22.11.0').

enableCorepack.description: Enable Corepack so yarn and pnpm are available and pinned per project. Ignored on Node.js releases that no longer bundle Corepack.
